title: Hearing on rent freeze and senior/disabled homeowner tax breaks
summary: The Council's Aging, Disabilities and Finance Committees held a joint oversight hearing on the Senior Citizen Rent Increase Exemption (SCRIE) and Disability Rent Increase Exemption (DRIE) programs, which freeze rent for low-income older and disabled tenants. The hearing also covered several bills to expand eligibility, simplify applications, and increase income limits for these programs and related property tax exemptions (SCHE and DHE), plus resolutions urging state action on related rent and tax relief measures. Under current rules, SCRIE and DRIE require household income of $50,000 or less, while SCHE and DHE cover homeowners earning up to $58,399.
